description: This file defines a middleware component for ASP.NET Core that handles exceptions occurring during HTTP request processing, returning JSON error responses and logging errors.

classes.name: ErrorHandlingMiddleware
classes.description: A middleware class that intercepts exceptions in the request pipeline, logs them, and returns appropriate JSON error responses.

methods.name: Invoke
methods.description: Async method that invokes the next middleware in the pipeline and catches exceptions to handle them.

methods.name: HandleExceptionAsync
methods.description: Private static method that processes exceptions, sets the HTTP response status code, serializes error details into JSON, and writes the response.
